citations.claim: first violation step 34 has theta -0.852 rad beyond 0.8 limit
one step before violation theta -0.619 rad within limit but rapidly growing
two steps before theta -0.400 rad shows accelerating divergence
at step 30 pole still near upright theta -0.032 rad before runaway

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.014549... to 0.0 (single-field change); with perfect sensing the same dt/plant/initial stays upright and no rule is violated, showing noise+large dt causes the pole_upright failure.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has large dt=0.0194 (near max) and sensor_noise=0.0145 with no pushes. Controller acts once per outer step on noisy angle measurement; the noise plus coarse discretization destabilizes the state-feedback loop. Trace shows pole error grows monotonically from near-upright (~0.03 rad at step 30) to violation: theta -0.203 at step31, -0.400 at step32, -0.619 at step33, -0.852 at step34 (>0.8). Zeroing sensor_noise alone (counterfactual) stabilizes the same plant/dt and eliminates violation, confirming noise-induced loss of pole upright with this dt/controller timing is the cause.
vision_note: From step 31 to 33 the pole leans progressively farther from upright with the tip still orange, showing steadily growing angle error while the cart remains on the track. At step 34 the pole is sharply angled and its tip turns red, visibly marking the pole_upright violation.
